claims.answer: Native macOS 26+ app (Apple Silicon and Intel not stated) with a prowl CLI; Remote Mirror (alpha) lets an experimental iOS or Android client or another Mac control Host terminals; no Windows, Linux, web or editor client.

evidence.finding: Hierarchy of repositories, worktrees, tabs and panes with agent states Blocked, Done, Working and Idle.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: agent-detection
evidence.finding: Process probe and screen heuristics detect agents and their Working, Blocked, Idle or Done state, including Devin, Antigravity and remote agents over SSH.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: active-agents
evidence.finding: One roster of every agent across worktrees, tabs and splits with states and keyboard cycling.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: agent-island
evidence.finding: Notch or menu-bar roster showing counts by state with Blocked and Done cells that jump to the pane.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: agent-profiles
evidence.finding: Named launch presets per runtime (model, effort, execution mode, placement, env vars, dedicated home); seeded for each installed CLI; argv-only by default.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: workflows
evidence.locator: What it is; Built-in Review Loop; Script actions and bundles; Sandbox access; Built-in Handoff
evidence.finding: Workflows (.pwlworkflow with workflow.yaml, schema prowl.workflow/v1) script live agent panes with roles, steps, typed state, loops and deliveries; built-in Review Loop (2-4 rounds default) and Handoff; history retained; size limits.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: cli
evidence.locator: Commands; prowl agents; dispatch completion and waiting; prowl workflow; Transport
evidence.finding: prowl CLI talks to the running app over a Unix socket: list, read, send, key, focus, create tab/pane, close, open, canvas, agents (read, signal, dispatch, wait), profiles, skills, workflow; --json envelopes with schema_version and error codes.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: canvas
evidence.finding: Zoomable board where every open tab is a live terminal card with broadcast typing and finished-card highlight.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: shelf
evidence.finding: Worktrees shown as vertical spines with tabs and agent status markers.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: workspaces
evidence.finding: Several linked repositories in one folder so an agent can work across them.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: remote-folders
evidence.finding: Remote projects over the user ssh with nothing installed on the host; tabs are shells on the host; worktrees list for remote repositories.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: repositories-and-worktrees
evidence.locator: worktree creation; Setup script; archive script
evidence.finding: First-class git worktrees created with Cmd-N; setup and archive scripts run on the worktree lifecycle.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: diff-view
evidence.finding: Diff window against HEAD and an Outgoing Changes mode against the PR base or configured base branch; read-only review of agent changes.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: github-pull-requests
evidence.finding: PR state, review decision, CI rollup, merge readiness and merge queue per worktree through the gh CLI; actions to mark ready, re-run failed jobs, copy failure logs, merge and close.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: notifications
evidence.locator: When a notification fires; Where unread shows up
evidence.finding: macOS notifications when an agent finishes or asks, command-finished alerts (10 s default), bell and unread indicators, Dock badge and bounce.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: custom-actions
evidence.finding: Toolbar buttons with hotkeys for repeated commands, global or per repository.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: updates
evidence.finding: Sparkle auto-update with hourly background checks and explicit install confirmation; notarized releases; Homebrew cask separate.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: terminal
evidence.finding: Terminal panes rendered by libghostty with Ghostty config support.

evidence.title: Prowl manual: settings
evidence.finding: Settings tabs including Agents, Remote Mirror, Advanced telemetry toggles and Shortcuts.

evidence.title: Prowl settings reference
evidence.finding: analyticsEnabled (PostHog, default true, off in Debug) and crashReportsEnabled (Sentry, default true) settings.

evidence.title: Prowl Remote Mirror
evidence.locator: Enable and pair; Take Over; Listen on
evidence.finding: Remote Mirror (alpha): off by default; paired iPhone or another Mac views and controls Host terminals over LAN or VPN with a 60-second pairing code and TLS; one remote owner per pane with explicit Take Over.

evidence.title: Prowl Mirror clients
evidence.finding: iOS and Android Remote Mirror clients are experimental native projects built from source in the repository; they add no targets to the Mac release pipeline.

evidence.title: Prowl Mirror Android README
evidence.finding: Android client builds a debug APK and is not yet a Play Store release configuration; MIT licensed.

evidence.title: Prowl Mirror iOS README
evidence.finding: iOS Mirror client has a make target that publishes to TestFlight via asc; no public join link in the pinned docs.

evidence.title: Prowl App/Sources/Clients/Analytics/AnalyticsClient.swift
evidence.finding: PostHog analytics client; events carry action names, anonymous install ID, versions and locale.

evidence.title: Prowl App/Project.swift
evidence.finding: XcodeGen/Tuist manifest for the native macOS app target.

evidence.title: Prowl CHANGELOG
evidence.finding: Dated changelog with frequent releases; v2026.11.16 is the pinned release.

evidence.title: Prowl bundled skills
evidence.finding: Bundled agent skills prowl-cli and prowl-workflow installed with prowl skills install and linked into the app bundle.

evidence.title: Bounded search: clients
evidence.locator: grep -Ei for electron, WKWebView, tauri, android app store, windows, linux, web client over App, CLI, Shared, docs
evidence.finding: No web, Windows, Linux or browser client; Mac app is native with no web views (README); mobile clients are the experimental Mirror projects.

evidence.title: Bounded search: team
evidence.locator: grep -Ei for oauth login, saml, sso, organization role, guest, share link over App, CLI, Shared, Mirror, docs
evidence.finding: No accounts, roles or SSO; Remote Mirror pairs devices of one user with one remote owner per pane.

evidence.title: Bounded search: cost
evidence.locator: grep -Ei for token usage, cost, spend, budget, billing over App, CLI, Shared, docs
evidence.finding: No token, cost or spend tracking and no billing code; matches are test names and UI code.

evidence.title: Bounded search: trigger
evidence.locator: grep -Ei for cron, schedule, webhook, launchd over App, CLI, Shared, docs
evidence.finding: No scheduler or webhook receiver; only file-watcher refresh scheduling and workflow watchdog code.

evidence.title: Bounded search: mcp
evidence.locator: grep -Ei for mcp over App, CLI, Shared, skills, docs
evidence.finding: No MCP client or server; matches are agent fixtures and a terminal-agent support test.

evidence.title: Bounded search: pr
evidence.locator: grep -Ei for create pull request, gh pr create over App, CLI, docs
evidence.finding: No pull request creation; PR actions are open, mark ready, re-run, merge and close on existing PRs through gh.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 677 stars on onevcat/Prowl; license FSL-1.1-ALv2 (GitHub reports Other/NOASSERTION); latest release v2026.11.16 published 2026-11-15.

evidence.title: Prowl v2026.11.16 release
evidence.finding: Release "Prowl 2026.11.16" published 2026-11-15 at commit ac3c164.

evidence.title: docs/components/workflows.md
evidence.finding: Finished workflow runs are removed three days after completion with no per-run protection or user retention setting; the global history budget is 5 GiB soft; Clear History deletes finished runs; Export writes a ZIP; run outputs expire with their run.

evidence.title: docs/components/terminal.md
evidence.finding: Layout (worktrees, tabs, splits, titles, folders) is saved on quit and each time Prowl stops being active, so a crash loses only changes since the last switch; restored panes start a new shell and running commands and agents do not start again.

evidence.title: docs/remote-mirror.md
evidence.finding: Disconnecting a mirror leaves the terminal running and the device paired so it can reconnect; saved credentials survive Host stop/start and app restart; one remote owner per pane.

evidence.title: README.md
evidence.locator: grep -rniE "terms of service|subscription|rate limit" docs README.md
evidence.finding: No provider terms or subscription restriction guidance appears in the README or manual; the only hits concern Remote Mirror subscriptions and a workflow rate limit.

evidence.title: docs/components/terminal.md
evidence.finding: Prowl documents no image or attachment input of its own; the image hit is the clipboard-read confirmation sheet and canvas cards are terminal screenshots for viewing.

evidence.title: docs/components/canvas.md
evidence.finding: No cap or measured count of simultaneous agents or panes is documented; the limits found are workflow size limits and round limits.

evidence.title: docs/components/remote-folders.md
evidence.finding: No host sizing guidance is documented for the Mac or remote hosts; README memory mentions are about telemetry fields.
